name: LottoLens PH Public PCSO Data API
description: Read-only static JSON access to a fixed, independently compiled snapshot of 13,457 Philippine PCSO draw-result rows and the normal schedule for nine games. No authentication is required. These immutable JSON files are served through GitHub Pages and CDN caching; clients should cache responses and avoid high-frequency polling. No application-level rate-limit headers are exposed. This is not an official PCSO database or a prediction service.
